verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation that llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX Runtime, or AMD's own AI stack supports the 9950X3D's CPU, GPU, or NPU. The only AI-related items are a generic 'Learn About Ryzen AI Software For Developers' link and a marketing line on the broad Ryzen family page, neither tied to this processor. AVX-512 support is an adjacent hardware feature, not documented runtime support.

support.subject: As a developer, mainstream local-AI runtimes target this silicon — llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX Runtime, or the vendor's own AI software stack document support for its CPU, GPU, or NPU
